resolved_conflicts.explanation: Newspaper items name three mountains: White Deer Mountain (1924), Bald Eagle Mountain (1939 and 1940) and Elmsport Mountain (1944). The sources do not reconcile them, so the story reports all three.
The April 1944 item opens by saying hikers are now allowed near the tower, but its body says the district had barred people from the site. The story follows the body.

notes_for_editor: The brief had only the 2008 registration event; built 1921 and removed 1975 were added from the register and the Forest Lookouts page, which are not errors in the record. The mountain names in the 1924, 1939-40 and 1944 items disagree (see resolved_conflicts). The April 1944 access item contradicts itself. No source describes current condition or public access. The Mapcarta entry is a map label, not a site report. Elevation in the brief (603.5 m) and the register (604 m) differ only by rounding, so no correction. Verification 2026-10-10: the December 1939 lease was signed with the state Department of Forests and Waters, not by the city council (the 1940 items show the mayor signing agreements), and the April 1944 request came from the Department, not the district; both corrected in the story.
